items.q: What did he think university was, before 中考?
items.a: A **nearby guaranteed 苏大**, like middle school. 清华 vs 北大 was a font problem. 职高 did not exist until the score.

items.q: Why did he cry into the backpack?
items.a: He thought **textbooks were over**. The 职高 was just worse scores, not *热血高校*.

items.q: What is the 长衫 in this clip?
items.a: The **16-year degree costume**. Parents paid for it. It hid 无能. Taking a breathing-only 化验员 seat felt like wasting it.

items.q: What did the factory interview actually test?
items.a: Write the **English alphabet**. The other guy waited to copy. HR: not chem, no promo, anyone who breathes can do it.

items.q: What is the title actually claiming?
items.a: **Error tolerance is higher** than the exam OS said. The sky-falling nights became roast copy. The industry dies first. Your life is still long.

items.q: What started the account 叫我死盖就好?
items.a: Walking the plant. HR said the job was real **and** that his life should not be that. A month later the account exists.
